productUrls.title: Amazon product or review URLs
productUrls.description: Product page URLs or review page URLs. The actor extracts the ASIN automatically. Example: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0D1XD1ZV3

asins.title: ASINs (alternative to URLs)
asins.description: Comma separated ASINs. Used only if productUrls is empty. Example: B0D1XD1ZV3,B09V3KXJPB

maxReviews.title: Maximum reviews per product
maxReviews.description: Hard cap per ASIN. Amazon shows up to ~100 reviews per sort order. Set higher to combine multiple sort passes.

filterByRating.title: Filter by star rating
filterByRating.description: Only return reviews with this star rating. Leave empty for all ratings.

verifiedOnly.title: Verified purchases only
verifiedOnly.description: Only return reviews marked as verified purchases.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy settings. Amazon blocks datacenter IPs. Use residential proxies if you see CAPTCHAs.
